failures.text: I got a call from someone saying he was from the CBI. He said I was under digital arrest. I paid 1 lakh 95,000 rupees by UPI this afternoon.
failures.ref: I got a call from someone saying he was from the CBI. He said I was under digital arrest. I paid one lakh ninety five thousand rupees by UPI this afternoon.
Saya terima panggilan daripada seseorang yang mengaku dari syarikat pinjaman. Dia kata pinjaman saya perlu yuran pemprosesan. Saya bayar dua ribu ringgit melalui DuitNow.
